generic.description: The schedule must be a GTFS ZIP file.

lines.title: Choose your lines
lines.description: Choose every line you want to follow.

stops.title: Choose your stops
stops.description: These stops get next departure and delay sensors. You can leave this empty.

persons.title: Additional settings
persons.description: Each chosen person gets a sensor showing the closest stop of your lines. GZM moves vehicles about every 15 s and changes delays about every 40 s, so an interval below 15 s gives nothing.
